comment: Registration input for course-repository content sources. Registered ContentSource rows are what decides which repositories exist; this file is only how a fresh database gets its first rows, in the same way scripts/production_like_course_specs.json seeds the course catalogue. Adding a repository here does not import it -- it makes it registerable, and the course-repository ingest (webhook or pull) does the rest. A repository without a course.yaml at its root cannot be ingested by either route. data-engineering-zoomcamp was missing from this list despite having a real course.yaml -- that was a gap, fixed 2026-09-03. mlops-zoomcamp and stock-markets-analytics-zoomcamp had no course.yaml at all (confirmed 404) despite each already having a real SITE.md; course.yaml was authored and pushed to both repositories the same day, following the exact schema data-engineering-zoomcamp uses, and both are now registered here too.
